swaps.pageTitle: HappySwaps by Happy Animals | Multichain DeFi
swaps.metaDescription: Discover HappySwaps by Happy Animals: swaps, pools, portfolio, rewards and activity across blockchain test networks.
swaps.eyebrow: PART OF THE HAPPY ANIMALS ECOSYSTEM
swaps.heroBody: A friendly way to explore token swaps, liquidity pools, your portfolio and rewards across supported blockchains—all from one interface.
swaps.featuresBody: HappySwaps is a separate application. Your wallet stays under your control: you review and sign every operation yourself.
swaps.swapBody: Exchange supported tokens with transparent quotes and fees.
swaps.poolsBody: Explore liquidity pools and manage supported positions.
swaps.portfolioBody: See your wallet balances and liquidity positions.
swaps.rewardsBody: Track verified achievements and experimental points, without promised cash rewards.
swaps.activityBody: Review operations and recover supported blockchain receipts.
swaps.networkBody: These are testnet pilots, not mainnet trading. Supported assets and operations vary by network; HyperEVM remains paused.
swaps.futureBody: Earn vaults and perpetual trading are being evaluated for the future. They are not live HappySwaps features today.
swaps.ctaBody: This page introduces HappySwaps. We will enable the app link after the testnet deployment and HTTPS checks are complete.
swapsDeck.introBody: Explore swaps, liquidity, portfolios, rewards and blockchain activity. A friendly interface with a personality of its own — in the Happy Animals universe.
swapsDeck.swapBody: A more understandable swap experience, with clear network choices and a review before signing.
swapsDeck.poolsBody: Explore liquidity pools and manage supported positions where the corresponding testnet implementation is available.
swapsDeck.portfolioBody: See supported balances and positions together while remaining in control of your own wallet.
swapsDeck.rewardsBody: Explore verified achievements and experimental points associated with eligible activity. No tokens or cash rewards are promised.
swapsDeck.activityBody: Review your supported operations and find the transactions behind your activity.
swapsDeck.networksBody: HappySwaps has testnet pilots on multiple networks. Available tokens, execution and rewards depend on each network — this page is not mainnet trading.
swapsDeck.securityBody: HappySwaps is independent from the Happy Animals NFT application. You review each transaction and sign it in your wallet.
swapsDeck.startBody: This is a visual preview. HappySwaps is in development; verified testnet deployment, HTTPS and supported features will determine when the application link can be activated.
swapsEnd.body: Explore HappySwaps and follow the project.
